description: Machinery release publication policy, single source for scripts/release-policy. Release requires successful ci, formal, and security runs on the EXACT release commit (workflow identity, run conclusion, and every required job conclusion, including the required integration lane), a tag matching the numeric version pattern, and main ancestry for the release commit. Schedule events are excluded as evidence: only deliberate push, pull_request, and workflow_dispatch runs count. This file is verified locally by go test ./scripts/release-policy against captured API response fixtures and real disposable git repositories; fixture tests are not live remote enforcement.
application_status: ready-to-apply but intentionally NOT applied: no GitHub branch protection, required checks, dispatch, publish, or any other remote mutation has been performed; locally tested policy is distinct from remotely enforced state

github_required_status_checks.apply_command: jq '.github_required_status_checks.payload' docs/release-policy.json | gh api -X PUT repos/RamXX/machinery/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks --input - (branch protection must already exist: gh api repos/RamXX/machinery/branches/main/protection)
github_required_status_checks.pre_apply_name_confirmation: gh api repos/RamXX/machinery/commits/<main-sha>/check-runs -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' --jq '.check_runs[].name' and confirm every context above exists verbatim, especially the four matrix-expanded build names, before applying; a context that never appears on a commit would block every merge
